abilities.name: Seal of Approval
_curatorNotes: Scarlet Seal economy (Pattern 4 / 5 hybrid): N hits, E hit, and burst Brilliance ticks (every 60f) each grant 1 seal up to maxTags (3, or 4 at C6). Seals persist for 10s (seal status), refresh on each grant, and are cleared on swap-off. ChargeAttack consumes all current seals; damage Mult and AoE radius scale with seal count (gcsim charge[sealCount][...] and chargeRadius=[2.5,3,3.5,4,4]). Reviewer to model the stack-state and the per-seal CA scaling.

Tier B per-character note (recipe-tier-b.md) claims 'gcsim uses two slices' for stack-loaded vs base CA frames, but the actual gcsim source has a single chargeFrames slice — frames are identical regardless of seal count; only Mult and radius scale. Per Pattern 4 'no animation change → don't split' rule, authored as one normal ability with a flag rather than a second normal entry with `state: inStance`.
A1 Proviso reduces CA stamina cost by 15% per seal (25% at C1+) via gcsim's ActionStam override. Stamina cost is not modeled in the planner (Pattern 5).

C1 (The Law Knows No Kindness) doubles the per-seal stamina reduction to 25% and adds interruption resist during CA release. Stamina is not modeled; interruption-resist is not in the schema. Flagged on the C1 entry.
C6 (Extra Clause) raises max seals from 3 to 4. The schema has no 'max stacks' field for the seal economy; reviewer to encode if a stack-state representation is added.

N1/N2 ActionAttack is not explicitly set in gcsim attack.go (animation default 26 / 28 per the gcsim '// Nx -> Nx+1' comments); per recipe rule (animation defaults from InitNormalCancelSlice are not real cancels), N is omitted on N1/N2.
N3 (final): gcsim sets ActionCharge=42 explicitly, but per recipe key-set convention (non-bow final = swap+N only, no C) C is dropped on the final hit.

chargeFrames: gcsim subtracts a 16-frame windup from every cancel value when CA is used outside Idle/Swap state (i.e. after a normal/skill/burst/etc.). Values recorded are the raw cold-open slice (windup=0). Effective post-N/E/Q windup: swap=43, E=47, Q=47, D=35, J=33.

plungeFrames: lowPlungeFrames recorded. highPlungeFrames also exists in gcsim (swap=50, N=58, E=59, Q=59, D=47) but is not represented; standard rotation uses low plunge. Catalyst plunge is gated on AirborneXianyun in gcsim — plunges are only available when launched by Xianyun support.

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description:
Shoots fireballs that deal up to three counts of Pyro DMG.
When Yanfei's Normal Attacks hit enemies, they will grant her a single Scarlet Seal. Yanfei may possess a maximum of 3 Scarlet Seals, and each time this effect is triggered, the duration of currently possessed Scarlet Seals will refresh.
Each Scarlet Seal will decrease Yanfei's Stamina consumption and will disappear when she leaves the field.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Consumes Stamina and all Scarlet Seals before dealing AoE Pyro DMG to opponents after a short casting time.
This Charged Attack's AoE and DMG will increase according to the amount of Scarlet Seals consumed.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Gathering the power of Pyro, Yanfei plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.

abilities.name: Signed Edict
_curatorNotes: behavior changed from generator stub 'persistent' to 'instant'. Signed Edict is a single AoE pyro hit at hitmark=32f with no spawned entity / no field lifetime — the description's 'summons blistering flames' is flavor only; gcsim has no persistence loop. The 'summon' tag is leftover from the generator and was kept for compatibility but is misleading.
On hit, grants Yanfei the maximum number of Scarlet Seals (sets sealCount = maxTags = 3, or 4 at C6) and refreshes the seal status timer to 10s. Reviewer to model the seal-grant trigger.
ActionAttack not explicit in skillFrames (animation default 46) — N omitted.
Skill cooldown: 540 frames = 9s. cooldownStartDelay: 28f from gcsim's c.SetCDWithDelay(ActionSkill, 540, 28).
abilities.description:
Summons blistering flames that deal AoE Pyro DMG.
Opponents hit by the flames will grant Yanfei the maximum number of Scarlet Seals.

abilities.name: Done Deal
_curatorNotes: Generator stub had `duration: 15` on the burst; deleted per recipe §3 (duration-bounded self-status with no spawned entity → 'instant' + flag). The 15s value is the Brilliance self-buff window on Yanfei (gcsim burstBuffKey, 15*60+1 frames), not an entity lifetime — `summons[]` is not authored.

Brilliance window (15s, ends on swap-off): (a) +DmgP CA bonus from gcsim burstBonus[talentLvlBurst] applied to AttackTagExtra hits via burstBuff modifier; (b) recurring 60f task adds 1 seal per second up to maxTags. Neither effect is authored in effects[]; reviewer to add the buff representation and the periodic seal grant trigger.
On cast: hits at frame 24 (burstHitmark), grants Yanfei max seals on hit (same as skill).
ActionAttack not explicit in burstFrames (animation default 58) — N omitted.

gcsim Burst calls c.ConsumeEnergy(5) at the end — appears to drain 5 additional energy on cast beyond the 80 cost; semantic unclear (possible off-by-one or refund mechanic). Energy cost 80 sourced from data_gen.textproto (burst_energy_cost). Flag for reviewer.
abilities.description:
Triggers a spray of intense flames that rush at nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG, granting Yanfei the maximum number of Scarlet Seals, and applying Brilliance to her.

Brilliance
Has the following effects:
·Grants Yanfei a Scarlet Seal at fixed intervals.
·Increases the DMG dealt by her Charged Attacks.
The effects of Brilliance will end if Yanfei leaves the field or falls in battle.

passives.name: Proviso
passives.caveat: The +15% Pyro DMG Bonus represents the max-stack value at C0 (3 seals × 5%). At C6 the max is +20% (4 seals × 5%). Per-seal scaling (5%/10%/15%/20%) is not authored — schema lacks per-stack buff-value scaling. Assert via notation: `Yanfei {seal:3} C` (or `{seal:4}` at C6).
_curatorNotes: Pyro DMG Bonus on CA hit, scales 5% × seals consumed (1–3 at C0, 1–4 at C6). Modelled as a max-stack flat buff (15%) gated on stacks: seal >= 3, with onHit charged trigger and 6s refresh duration. The full per-stack-scaling primitive is deferred (would let the value be `{ type: "perStack", key: "seal", per: 5 }`).

Trigger: onHit ability=charged. Note that the team buffs row currently only collects onCast effects, so this buff doesn't render in that row regardless of stacks state — the schema gating is correct but visualisation is limited until onHit-buff display lands.

Per-cast filtering of stack-gated effects is a v1 limitation: timeline preview's evalCondition has no stack context (returns null), so the buff would render unconditionally if/when onHit buff display is added. Future timeline-side per-cast stamping will fix this.
passives.description: When Yanfei consumes Scarlet Seals by using a Charged Attack, each Scarlet Seal will increase Yanfei's Pyro DMG Bonus by 5%. This effect lasts for 6s. When a Charged Attack is used again during the effect's duration, it will dispel the previous effect.

passives.name: Blazing Eye
_curatorNotes: Inherited `trigger: manual`. Likely `onHit` with `ability: chargeAttack` and `requireCrit: true`; gcsim caps to once per CA via a `done` boolean (one extra hit per Charged Attack regardless of seal count). Damage counts as Charged Attack DMG (snapshot at CA cast time). Reviewer to author the trigger.
passives.description: When Yanfei's Charged Attack deals a CRIT Hit to opponents, she will deal an additional instance of AoE Pyro DMG equal to 80% of her ATK. This DMG counts as Charged Attack DMG.

constellations.name: The Law Knows No Kindness
_curatorNotes: Two effects, neither modeled: (a) per-seal stamina reduction is doubled (gcsim sealStamReduction 0.15 → 0.25), but stamina is not in the planner; (b) interruption-resist during CA release has no schema field. No effect skeleton authored.
constellations.description: When Yanfei uses her Charged Attack, each existing Scarlet Seal additionally reduces the stamina cost of this Charged Attack by 10% and increases resistance against interruption during its release.

constellations.name: Right of Final Interpretation
_curatorNotes: First effect (critRate +20) is correct in shape but the conditions are missing: it applies to Yanfei's Charged Attack only and only against enemies below 50% HP. gcsim implements via an AttackMod gated on `AttackTagExtra` and the target's `HP/MaxHP < 0.5`. Inherited `trigger: manual`; likely `onHit` with `ability: chargeAttack` + an enemy-HP condition. Schema has no enemy-HP-threshold condition currently — reviewer to encode.
Second effect (`hp%` 50) is a generator misinterpretation of the description's '<50% HP' enemy condition — it is NOT a self-buff that grants +50% HP. Recommend deletion on reviewer pass.
constellations.description: Increases Yanfei's Charged Attack CRIT Rate by 20% against enemies below 50% HP.
